quizzes.title: Asthma and Allergy: Anti-Allergen Cleaning and Treatment — Knowledge Check

questions.questionText: Denaturing treatments are designed to alter allergen proteins. What must you check before relying on one?
options: Nothing — the product class works the same way regardless of brand
The manufacturer's independent test evidence (for example Der p 1 or Fel d 1 data) and the current label — never assume efficacy from marketing
Only the price per litre
Whether the supplier offers a discount for bulk purchase

questions.questionText: Before applying an anti-allergen treatment to carpet you must always:
options: Spray the whole room immediately
Test for colourfastness in an inconspicuous area
Raise the room temperature above 30 °C
Remove all furniture from the house

questions.questionText: Which of these is a key Australian WHS control when applying treatment products?
options: Working alone to save time
Wearing the PPE specified by the product label and SDS
Skipping documentation for small jobs
Mixing products to boost strength

questions.questionText: If a manufacturer states a residual effect period for an allergen-denaturing treatment (for example "up to six months"), how should you treat that claim?
options: Quote it to the customer as a guaranteed relief period
As the manufacturer's own claim — verify it on their current label and technical data, and never present it to customers as a guarantee
Ignore it — residual effects do not exist
Double it when quoting, to be safe

questions.questionText: When quoting an anti-allergen service in Australia you should:
options: Copy US pricing from the manufacturer
Quote in AUD from your own chemical cost per square metre and labour rate
Always match the cheapest competitor
Quote only after the job is done
